summary: Anthropic published an analysis mapping 832 accounts banned for AI-enabled malicious cyber activity onto the MITRE ATT&CK framework, finding that AI use is shifting toward more autonomous, post-compromise attack stages and that current frameworks fail to capture this agentic orchestration.

practices.reason: The report discloses an internal risk-scoring methodology for classifying cyberattacker sophistication that could inform how security teams think about measuring AI-enabled threats, though the scoring system itself is not handed over as a usable instrument.
practices.quote: applying our risk-scoring methodology to this attack earns it the maximum risk score of 100
